headline: FedEX beefs up trans-Pacific air cargo network
summary: FedEx expanded its trans-Pacific air freight network ahead of the year-end shipping season, adding 567,000 kilograms of weekly capacity between Asia-Pacific and the United States. Routes include the Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam, China and Hong Kong.
why: FedEx is a major global express and air cargo carrier, and capacity changes on trans-Pacific routes signal demand for air freight between Asian manufacturing hubs and the US.

impacts.name: FedEx
impacts.why: Adding weekly air capacity lets the company carry more year-end volume on trans-Pacific routes.
